summary: You index the knowledge base with metadata and add GET /api/search: top-k cited chunks, a kind filter, checked parameters, a clean 503 when the database is down, and tests that need no database and no model.

items.text: Run ingest.py and match the 26 chunks by kind
Add the SearchHit and SearchResponse models and the /api/search route
Add get_embedder and get_store as dependencies
Write the API tests with a fake embedder and an in-memory store, and see them pass
Ask with curl, then try a wrong kind, top_k=50 and a stopped database
Add the README section, then commit and push
Play the Search Endpoint Check game to the end and see your score
